why: theorem_7_3 and B agree: (1) is identical (Mathlib PartitionOfUnity on |X|, IsSubordinate, index type in Type); in (2) A's saturated open neighbourhood W ⊆ X meeting finitely many tsupports corresponds to B's open V ⊆ |X| with π⁻¹(V) meeting finitely many (V = π(W), open since π is open, Proposition 7.1, and π⁻¹(π(W)) = W; conversely W = π⁻¹(V), open and saturated since π is continuous and surjective), and invariance β(s φ) = β(t φ) is B's IsoB y z → β y = β z. A also lists two lemmas about the project's construction orbitPullback (σ ∘ π) that B does not mention; they are proved outright in B ⇒ A from supp(σ∘π) ⊆ π⁻¹(supp σ) and local finiteness of the supports at π(x).
overlap: Both directions rt_check OK. B_to_A shares 16 project theorems: groupoid/orbit-setoid basics (src_comp, tgt_inv, Isomorphic.trans, surjective_π, ...), continuous_π, and the proof fields of orbitPullback (which appears in A's statement).
